decision_rule: mean gain >= .02, positive bootstrap lower limit, Holm p <= .05 for t, Wilcoxon, and corrected-resampled t across three variants; matched-control gain must also be positive
all_wrong_policy: zero sample weight; uniform target placeholder
hard_tie_policy: highest positive signed margin; first kernel for exact ties
margin_weighted_target: positive OOF signed margins normalized over correct experts
bank_policy: fit alignment teacher within each inner fold; fit full outer-training teacher; freeze outer theta for every imitation and matched-control gate
inference_scope: exploratory repeated splits of the same finite Wine dataset; not independent population replications
